rework_required.detail: The M1-02 RPH submit-intent key layout (project:record:research:round-N:submit:plan-<64 hex>) exceeds the M1-01b wire-key grammar (8..128 chars) and was refused by the MCP adapter with input_invalid/pattern. The bridge now sends a deterministic rph.<sha256> projection of the persisted intent key; the layout itself is unchanged.

The bridge's model-facing redaction guard refuses the whole acp_capabilities payload because it carries an inert `authorization` projection (credential_in_result at $.data.capability_request.authorization) and absolute backend paths. Discovery therefore cannot be projected through the bridge as-is; the slice reads it on the raw transport and records the refusal.

The prepare response names the artifact `artifact_ref.resource_id` with an empty digest and `availability=absent`, while the frozen read contract requires `artifact_ref.artifact_id` and a digest; the bridge's read builder still emits the legacy flat names unless the caller supplies a digest. The slice polls the prepare operation and maps resource_id→artifact_id locally.

Prepare operations report availability `ready`, while the C experience contract freezes `unprepared|preparing|readable|failed`. A consumer that trusts the C vocabulary sees no valid state for a successful prepare.
The MCP machine envelope redacts project_id/approval_ref/reservation ids as '<redacted>'. The TaskRef survives, but a client cannot reconstruct the full submit binding from the response alone.

The synthetic `fake` workflow runs on the legacy path, so the Controller returns release_id=null. The slice uses the real local release builder identity for the TaskRef/receipt and declares it as a stub-boundary value.

Evidence report bytes are A's frozen schema fixture with the subject rewritten; claim sources are static fixture artifacts.
The supervisor's approve port receives the real approval state read over HTTP by the orchestrator; it is not yet a platform call made by the supervisor itself (M3-04).
Remote/LSF evidence reads are not wired in this slice (local work dir only).
The bridge's model-facing projection currently refuses capabilities and prepare envelopes (F2/F3); M3-01b must resolve the guard/field contract.
